title: Cassava Pone
description: Cassava Pone is a dish from Guyana featuring cassava root, coconut, coconut milk. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used.

steps.instruction: Peel and coarsely grate the listed vegetables; squeeze out excess moisture so the mixture will hold together.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Layer the previously prepared components evenly inside a baking dish, serving mold or plate appropriate to the recipe; smooth the surface and avoid mixing the layers.
Bake grated cassava thoroughly until the center is fully set, with no raw wet cassava remaining; use properly peeled food-grade cassava root.
Serve the dish at the intended temperature and garnish as needed with previously prepared ingredients.
